__doc:
Issue #1826 — the row the issue itself calls the majority: "the rest of the same file".

The issue lists `unused import, max function length, every public class has a
docstring` as broken because the shard only sees a hunk. The claim checker
covers the first of those and only the first: `unused` is a verifiable
assertion. Length and in-file duplication assert nothing a grep can refute, so
nothing downstream can rescue them — the judge has to SEE the scope or it
cannot apply the rule at all.

Each rule runs twice: with `contextNeed: full-file` declared, and
byte-identical without. Run this BEFORE implementing full-file as well:
needOf() does not know that value today and falls through to diff-only, so
both arms measure the broken state, and the same unedited file measures the
fix afterwards.

F2 is the guard. A "fix" that merely makes the length rule fire more often
passes F1 and fails F2.

cases.why: buildMonthlyReport is 58 lines long. The hunk shows 4 of them, from the middle. Nothing in the diff carries the length, so a shard judging the hunk cannot apply this rule at all — it can only guess. The enclosing function is the whole of what is needed.
cases.prBody: Adds an audited/pending split to the monthly report.
